name: fan_polynomial_identification
title: Fan dimensionless coefficients from one catalogue point
summary: Evaluates the affinity-law flow, pressure and power coefficients of a fan at one catalogue point (volume flow, pressure rise, motor power, diameter and speed), with a fixed air density. The quadratic fits stated in the Laborelec file are recorded as a result comment.

verification.summary: compare_solution.py --ees-units: 13 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 1.
